mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_instrument ( customer_id, reconciliation_job_id, category_no, pack_name, department, package_material, patient_name, usage_date, pack_count, instrument_count, unit_price, total_amount, notes, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{reconciliationJobId}, #{categoryNo}, #{packName}, #{department}, #{packageMaterial}, #{patientName}, #{usageDate}, #{packCount}, #{instrumentCount}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{notes}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE external_instrument SET category_no = #{categoryNo}, pack_name = #{packName}, department = #{department}, package_material = #{packageMaterial}, patient_name = #{patientName}, usage_date = #{usageDate}, pack_count = #{packCount}, instrument_count = #{instrumentCount}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, notes = #{notes}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
